title: ATOMS: ALMA Three-millimeter Observations of Massive Star-forming regions - VIII. A search for hot cores by using C<SUB>2</SUB>H<SUB>5</SUB>CN, CH<SUB>3</SUB>OCHO, and CH<SUB>3</SUB>OH lines
question: To build a large sample of hot cores using C2H5CN, CH3OCHO, and CH3OH lines from the ATOMS 3 mm survey, and investigate their heating mechanisms and nitrogen/oxygen chemical differentiation.

data.arrays: 12-m array used for analysis (observed with both ACA 7-m and 12-m array)
data.sensitivity: mean 1 sigma better than 10 mJy beam^-1 per channel for lines, and 0.4 mJy beam^-1 for continuum

what.value: Catalog of 453 compact dense cores and initial 90 hot core candidates in 146 massive clumps

evidence.quote: 90 out of a total of 453 compact dense cores have been considered as hot core candidates based on number of emission lines (Liu et al. 2021).
As stated before, 453 compact dense cores were found in 146 massive clumps (Liu et al. 2021).
Considering the distances (Liu et al. 2021a) and source sizes, the 60 cores have source size smaller than 0.1 pc.

recipe.goal: Inspect cores, extract spectra, and select hot core candidates
recipe.method: Inspect line emission of the 453 compact dense cores one by one, extract spectra at the line-rich positions, and select line-rich cores with >3 transitions of COMs.
key_parameters: More than 3 transitions of C2H5CN, CH3OCHO, or CH3OH detected

recipe.goal: Identify molecular lines and derive rotation temperatures, column densities, and relative abundances
recipe.method: Solve the radiative transfer equation and generate synthetic spectra for C2H5CN, CH3OCHO, and CH3OH using XCLASS and optimize parameters with MAGIX.
key_parameters: Source size fixed to deconvolved angular size of the continuum source (theta_source = sqrt(a*b))
Velocity offset fixed with reference to CH3OH line at 100.6389 GHz
Hot core criteria: T_rot > 100 K and source size < 0.1 pc
assumptions: For cores with <3 CH3OH transitions detected, CH3OH gas temperature is assumed equal to T_rot of CH3OCHO (or C2H5CN if CH3OCHO is undetected)

recipe.goal: Map spatial distributions and identify N/O chemical differentiation and heating mechanisms
recipe.method: Create line images of C2H5CN (98523 MHz), CH3OCHO (98792 MHz), CH3OH (100639 MHz), H40alpha (99023 MHz), and SiO (86847 MHz), and compare their emission peak positions with continuum and H40alpha peaks.
key_parameters: Position accuracy threshold of 0.3 arcsec (from 1.9 arcsec resolution and 3 sigma S/N)
assumptions: Hot cores adjacent to H40alpha-traced UC HII regions with CH3OH peaks offset from the continuum peak are externally heated

recipe.goal: Statistical analysis of rotation temperatures and column densities
recipe.method: Perform linear fittings between rotation temperatures and log column densities and between log column densities of different species, and apply Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) tests comparing externally and internally heated hot cores.

evidence.loc: Rotation temperatures, column densities and abundances relative to CH$_3$OH
evidence.quote: The relative abundances range from 8.4$\times$10$^{-4}$ to 4$\times$10$^{-2}$ for C$_2$H$_5$CN and from 2.2$\times$10$^{-2}$ to 2.8 $\times$10$^{-1}$ for CH$_3$OCHO, respectively, which are in agreement with previous results in hot cores (Bøelund et al. 2019; Mookerjea et al. 2007; Allen et al. 2017; Guzmán et al. 2018; Law et al. 2021; Feng et al. 2016; Bonfand et al. 2017, 2019; Molet et al. 2019; Qin et al. 2010).

answer_key.quantity: Number of hot cores showing spatial N and O separation

evidence.quote: Considering position accuracy of 0.3 arcsec in line images, 29 cores clearly show nitrogen and oxygen separation, i.e., the emissions of C$_2$H$_5$CN and CH$_3$OCHO peak at different positions.

answer_key.quantity: Number of externally heated hot cores

evidence.quote: Based on the spatial position difference between hot cores and UC Hii regions, we conclude that 24 hot cores are externally heated while the other hot cores are internally heated.

score_reason: The ALMA project code is public, the software tools (CASA 5.6, XCLASS, MAGIX) are standard and open, and the source coordinates, fixed source sizes, and derived physical parameters for all 60 cores are fully tabulated in Table 1. However, imaging details are deferred to companion papers, and the exact spectral extraction apertures and MAGIX optimization configurations are not explicitly specified.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data (2019.1.00685.S), well-defined LTE spectral fitting methodology using public software (XCLASS), and a comprehensive numeric answer key in Table 1 (rotation temperatures, column densities, and relative abundances for 60 cores) as well as linear regression slopes and K-S test results.
